definition.name: Reuse the authenticated df4 component for late managed facilities

steps.name: Fetch only the two immutable source objects used by authentication
steps.run:
git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin 6fd19eab2c224fc31481d03de5008de4d3e4429e
git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin df4f5628add1a9ba9b1562ee00353fad57e4f7d5

steps.name: Check the exact current reader and preserved late-callback boundaries
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install -r tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_dotnet_resource_runtime tools.tests.test_resource_late_facilities tools.tests.test_resource_late_workflows tools.tests.test_replay_dotnet_resource_late -v

steps.name: Authenticate the same frozen 6fd products without rebuilding
Authenticate the complete failed df4 artifact and completed AOT package
Sign and execute only the original two denials and four late-fresh calls
Retain the original failure and bounded new node outcomes

with.name: dotnet-resource-late-replay-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-resource-late-replay-native/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-resource-late-replay-inputs/artifact.zip
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-resource-late-replay-inputs/retrieval.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-resource-late-replay/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-resource-late-replay/node/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-resource-late-replay/node/node-stderr.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-resource-late-replay/node/commands/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-resource-late-replay/node/examples-controls/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-resource-late-replay/node/foreign-controls/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-resource-late-replay/node/signed/my-greeting/build-observation.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-resource-late-replay/node/signed/release-set.json

reviewReason: Reviewed security fork identities only; commands, permissions, inputs, conditions and historical coverage are preserved.
